description: This Java class 'MerchantConfig' models the configuration settings for a merchant in the system, including display options and search configurations. It also provides functionality to serialize its data to a JSON string.

classes.name: MerchantConfig
classes.description: A model class that stores various display options and configuration maps for merchant settings, with serialization to JSON.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the MerchantConfig object into a JSON string, including display flags and configuration maps.

methods.name: setDisplayCustomerSection
methods.description: Sets the flag for displaying the customer section.

methods.name: isDisplayCustomerSection
methods.description: Returns whether the customer section display is enabled.

methods.name: setDisplayContactUs
methods.description: Sets the flag for displaying the contact us section.

methods.name: isDisplayContactUs
methods.description: Returns whether the contact us section display is enabled.

methods.name: setDisplayStoreAddress
methods.description: Sets the flag for displaying the store address.

methods.name: isDisplayStoreAddress
methods.description: Returns whether the store address display is enabled.

methods.name: setUseDefaultSearchConfig
methods.description: Sets the map for default search configuration.

methods.name: getUseDefaultSearchConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the map of default search configuration.

methods.name: setDefaultSearchConfigPath
methods.description: Sets the map for default search configuration paths.

methods.name: getDefaultSearchConfigPath
methods.description: Retrieves the map of default search configuration paths.

methods.name: setDisplayAddToCartOnFeaturedItems
methods.description: Sets the flag for displaying 'Add to Cart' on featured items.

methods.name: isDisplayAddToCartOnFeaturedItems
methods.description: Returns whether 'Add to Cart' on featured items is enabled.
